explains: ROOT_URLCONF in config/settings/base.py changes from the literal "config.urls" to os.environ.get("PORTAL_URLCONF", "config.urls"). A call is not a literal, so which URLconf is the root, and therefore which routes the project has, is not known: no route is claimed, none is called removed, and the run records that the root URLconf was not established (blocking). It does not guess config.urls from the default argument.

must_exclude.why: without a root URLconf no route can be composed
